author: Mark Atwood
text:
Federation draft survey complete.

Read all 690 lines end-to-end, audited the 84 MUSTs through Patterns A-E:

Cross-references and recent commits verified clean:
- c93e545 (Space owner -> impl-defined): no drift. 'owner' uses in federation draft are mailbox-owner (RFC 8620) sense or federation 'role: owner' (account-tier name, distinct from Space governance).
- 9344aec (emoji authorization): no drift. Federation Peer/deliver reactionUpdate relays opaque emoji strings.
- 38055ec (per-method auth latitude): partial coverage. Federation :451 sender-side admin check is structurally similar but uses ChatMember.role rather than Space permissions; not literally covered. Filed as uy1m.6.
- 970bad6 (server-side authorization model): no drift. Federation authz uses local-view receiver check (correct pattern).
- 2fd3cf7 (group-chat bootstrap impl-defined): consistent with federation Peer/groupUpdate 'create' rule (:485) — sender MUST be in members but not required to be admin.
- 87qs/dim0 (blocked-sender suppression): federation Peer/typing :378-380 and Peer/presence :589 (just fixed under 87qs) both have the rule.

Findings filed:
- uy1m.6 (P3): Federation :451 sender-side 'MUST be an admin of the identified group on the sending server' is overdetermined. Wire contract is the receiver-side check at :485-486 (verifies admin role on receiver's local Chat record). Sender-side MUST is a courtesy that prevents a deployment with impl-defined admin authorization from invoking Peer/groupUpdate even when its receiver-side check would succeed. Notes the parallel sites in the main draft (:369, :882) for follow-up but keeps the bead scoped.

Items already covered by other beads (NOT re-filed):
- Federation :395 Peer/typing 3s rate limit: tracked under ic5s T3-2 (calibrated against main draft).
- Federation :399 receiveTypingIndicators 60s cache TTL: tracked under uy1m 2E.
- Federation :533 Peer/presence 30s rate limit: tracked under uy1m 2F.
- Federation :597 persistent outbox mandate: tracked under uy1m 2D.

Items considered and rejected as findings:
- :644 ULID lexicographic race resolution: SHOULD with rationale, deterministic-tiebreaker choice (min vs max) is arbitrary but standardized; SHOULD opt-out documented. Reasonable shape.
- :601 retry/backoff intervals: already impl-defined.
- :509 Peer/subscribePresence TTL: already impl-defined.
- :311 ReadDisposition default 'displayed': sensible historical default, not really overdetermined.
- :318/328 Peer/receipt sender + receiver suppression: defense-in-depth, not redundancy.
- :318 receipt-sharing 'Sender Behavior': MUST suppress outbound is privacy-correct.
- :246-248 replyTo/threadRootId translation MUST: rationale provided in-text.
- :134 authentication mechanism: already impl-defined with non-exhaustive examples.

No additional overdetermination findings beyond uy1m.6.
